description: This file defines a utility class 'Log' for logging within an Android project, acting as an abstraction over Android's native Log class. It includes logging level constants, getter and setter for LogNode, and a suite of convenience methods for different log levels, supporting chaining of LogNodes.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class that provides static methods and constants for logging, wrapping Android's native Log and supporting a chain of LogNodes.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates log message to the current LogNode, including optional throwable.
